messages:
marco: Thanks everyone for the questions in today's AH. Dropping follow-ups and owners for the reliability incident.
marco: Long-form RCA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RCA-INC-2026-03-14
marco: TL;DR: policy-router fallback + cache eviction race resulted in sustained routing errors for hosted API for ~6h. We exceeded our circuit-breaker thresholds and the auto-fallback amplified load.
olivia: Will the planned router rewrite be the final mitigation or are we doing layered fixes?
jordan: Layered. Immediate: config hardening + KV eviction tuning (hotfix). Medium: safer fallback defaults + tighter circuit-breaker thresholds. Long: router rewrite to simplify policy evaluation.
jordan: Hotfix plan (owner @jordan): canary today 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback if error_rate >0.5% for 5m. Tracking: https://go/rdw/INC-2026-router
sumit: SLO implications: propose pausing non-critical autoscale experiments and adjusting burn thresholds until post-rewrite validation. I'll own the SLO doc.
sara: I'll prepare the customer-facing blurb and a short FAQ. Draft by tomorrow 09:00 PT. Owner: @sara.
kelly: PMs — do you want a one-pager for sales and CSMs after the blurb is ready?
jamal: Also: can we confirm whether Dedicated customers saw any impact? Need to flag CSMs if so.
jordan: Dedicated not impacted in this incident; separate router pool. We'll still run config tests in staging for Dedicated next week.
marco: Action list from AH Q&A:
- RCA link (full): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RCA-INC-2026-03-14
- Hotfix & canary: owner @jordan, ETA: today EOD (tracking above)
- Fallback defaults tighten: owner @olivia, rollout: immediate
- SLO/alert review and runbook update: owner @sumit, deliverable: updated alerts + postmortem addendum
- Customer comms draft: owner @sara, due tomorrow 09:00 PT
- Sales/CS one-pager: owner @kelly, dependent on @sara
- Postmortem deep dive invite: owner @marco, tentative Mon 09:30 PT
marco: Please react :white_check_mark: if you accept, :eyes: if supporting.
olivia: :white_check_mark:
jordan: :white_check_mark:
sara: :white_check_mark:
sumit: :eyes:
kelly: :eyes:
jamal: Quick perf question: widening fallback window — expected p99 impact?
jordan: Benchmarks: p99 up ~1-2% on routed path. We'll include perf metrics in canary reports.
maria: Can we add a test case to the chaos harness to simulate KV eviction + policy fallback race? I'll add it to eng-ml test board.
marco: Good idea. Owner: @maria for test case; target for inclusion before rewrite testing.
eng-oncall-bot: Use `/inc logs INC-2026` for raw logs. Contact @eng-oncall for bucket access.
marco: We'll post a short status update here after Monday's sync for stakeholders. Thanks everyone for the quick inputs.
alex: Happy to join the postmortem deep dive. Add me to the invite.
marco: Adding @alex. End of thread.
